comment: v0.2.6 source-package pin (non-tty path only): a valid NEW-format pak is built in pkg/ and installed into app/ through the runner's standard invocation, which is non-interactive (the runner captures stdout/stderr and never allocates a tty; see tests/v0.2.5/package-test/runner.py). Pinned: install succeeds, the consumer builds and runs, and - the point of this fixture - the SOURCE .cp3pak FILE STILL EXISTS after the install (filesExist on ../pkg/.cp3/out/pak_promptkeep.cp3pak, resolved against the install step's cwd, the app/ folder). The interactive prompt (whether the installer asks to keep/delete the source pak) cannot be exercised in this harness, and its question text is deliberately NOT pinned: the fix has not landed, and a guessed substring would either false-fail a correct implementation or silently pin nothing. The interactive path is a documented manual verification for the maintainer (see README.md in this folder); this fixture pins the non-tty/default path only.
